🚨 Hansi Flick's press-conference ahead of tomorrow's UCL game against Sabah FK:

“We have a lot of games coming up before the end of the year, and it’s important that all the players get minutes. We’ll try to manage things in the best possible way.” #fcblive #UCL

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick, on Frenkie de Jong: “What I like most about him is that he can play in almost every position. He gives everything for the team. He’s a midfielder, but we’ll see where we need him tomorrow.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick on Lamine Yamal’s absence: “We’ve played without Lamine before, so I think we know what we have to do to win. Why was he rested? We examined him yesterday morning and then decided that it would be best for him to stay in Barcelona and rest.” #fcblive

🚨 Journalist: “Hello, Frenkie… Sorry, I mean Flick!”

Flick: “No problem! You’ve made me feel younger. Thank you! (laughs)” #fcblive 😭
🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick, on Pau Cubarsí: “He’s available and can play tomorrow. He has missed the last two games. If we can manage without him tomorrow, we’ll rest him.” #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “Frenkie de Jong is a team-first player. He always thinks about the team.” #fcblive ⭐

🚨🎙️| Pep Guardiola: "When I arrived at Barcelona, the polls only gave me 3 or 4% support. NOBODY wanted me. I was coming straight from the reserve team while the first team was struggling. ​I thought to myself: 'Perfect. Nobody wants me. That's the best thing that could happen.'" #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Pep Guardiola on whether anyone will ever reach Lionel Messi's level: "NO, I don't think so. I don't think I'll see it in my lifetime. Maintaining that level for 15 or 20 years, every three days, with that BEAUTY and difficulty. I just don't see it." #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Pep Guardiola: "Which club i enjoyed managing most? Barcelona has been SPECIAL.​ I have a very deep emotional connection to Barça. I was a ball boy there, Barcelona means a great deal to me, and that's where my journey began." #fcblive ❤️

🚨🎙️| Pep Guardiola on which current player can become one of football's all-time greats: "Lamine Yamal, I think he has something different, something SPECIAL. He also has that desire to be the BEST, and that's a great quality." #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Pep Guardiola: "Coaching Messi? Trust me, I've NEVER seen another player like him capable of scoring 3 goals and registering 3 assists every 3 days. Very few can sustain that level of consistency, yet he delivered it in both official matches and training. In four years of training sessions, I can't recall him losing a single small-sided game. He possessed that fierce competitive edge, and I believe that's what truly set him apart." #fcblive 🐐
